title: UAV-Assisted Communications With RF Energy Harvesting: A Comprehensive Survey
affiliation: NIT Silchar India, IIIT Allahabad India, NTNU Norway, NTU Singapore
domain: UAV Communications / RF Energy Harvesting / SWIPT / B5G Wireless Networks

analysis_policy.focus: Extract UAV-EH integration taxonomy, SWIPT receiver architectures, and state-of-the-art technique categorization
analysis_policy.depth: Full paper analysis including 10 sections and extensive literature tables

terminology_standardization.SWIPT: Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer

section_flow.title: Introduction
section_flow.summary: Motivates RF-EH integration with UAV communications for B5G networks. Provides two detailed comparison tables (Table II, III) contrasting prior surveys.
key_claims: IoT connections projected to grow from 15.7B (2023) to 38.9B (2029)
UAV's SWAP constraints limit operational duration
First comprehensive survey on RF-EH for diverse UAV-enabled communications
Covers standardization, industrial developments, and channel modeling

section_flow.title: UAV Communications: Preliminaries, Developments, and Challenges
section_flow.summary: Comprehensive UAV taxonomy by flying mechanism, payload, altitude, power source. Details 3GPP Rel-15/17/18 standards, IEEE/ITU standards. Lists industrial projects (Google Loon, Amazon Prime Air, Nokia F-cell, etc.).
key_claims: UAVs classified by: physics (fixed/rotary/hybrid), payload, altitude (HAP/LAP), power source, tethering
3GPP Rel-17 specifies CCC modes and KPIs for UAV services
UAV market expected to grow from $26.2B (2022) to $38.3B (2027)
Energy constraints split into communication and propulsion energy

section_flow.title: EH Techniques: Preliminaries and Developments
section_flow.summary: Comprehensive EH technique taxonomy (solar, thermal, mechanical, RF) in Table VI. Details RF-EH receiver architectures: separate, TS, PS, antenna switching, hybrid TS-PS. Lists EH-based research projects.
key_claims: RF-EH power density: μW-mW range with 50-75% conversion efficiency
Dedicated vs ambient RF sources categorization
Four SWIPT receiver architectures: separate, TS, PS, antenna switching
Hybrid TS-PS outperforms individual protocols at different SNR regimes

section_flow.title: EH With UAV Communications
section_flow.summary: Original analytical modeling with composite Nakagami-m/shadowing channel. Derives OP, ST, EE expressions. Provides numerical insights on PS factor optimization.
key_claims: Two scenarios: EH-empowered UAV vs UAV-enabled EH
Composite channel: Nakagami-m + log-normal shadowing
OP minimum at β=0.45-0.65 PS factor range
Higher target rates require lower optimal β values

section_flow.title: EH in UAV Communications With Physical Layer Techniques
section_flow.summary: Extensive literature review organized by physical layer technique. Each subsection has summary table + key insights.
key_claims: m-MIMO UAVs reduce interference through 3D beamforming
NOMA-empowered UAVs leverage SIC and superposition coding
AmBSCs enable μW power consumption for IoT devices
Multi-UAV swarms improve coverage but face collision avoidance challenges

section_flow.title: EH in UAV-Enabled Communication Networks
section_flow.summary: Literature categorized by network type with summary tables. Covers DF/AF relaying, spectrum sensing, LEO/GEO SATN integration.
key_claims: DF outperforms AF at high SNR; AF more robust at low SNR
CRNs enable spectrum-efficient UAV communications
SATNs provide global coverage with reduced latency via UAV middle layer
IoT-UAV integration addresses remote sensing and data collection

section_flow.title: EH in UAV Communications With Advanced Computing Technologies
section_flow.summary: Analysis of MEC integration with EH-UAV communications for task offloading and computation.
key_claims: UAV-MEC reduces latency for computation-intensive IoT tasks
Joint EH and computation offloading optimization required

section_flow.title: EH in UAV Communications With ML/AI Algorithms
section_flow.summary: ML/AI techniques for trajectory optimization, resource allocation, and EH parameter tuning.
key_claims: DRL solves high-dimensional trajectory optimization
Federated learning enables privacy-preserving UAV coordination

section_flow.title: Future Research Directions
section_flow.summary: Identifies open challenges: RIS integration, THz communication, security, standardization, sustainable UAV design.
key_claims: RIS-UAV integration for enhanced EH and coverage
THz bands for high-capacity UAV fronthaul
Blockchain for secure UAV coordination

section_flow.title: Conclusion
section_flow.summary: Summarizes RF-EH as viable solution for UAV power constraints; emphasizes need for continued standardization and practical implementations.

rhetorical_contract.promise: Provide comprehensive survey on RF-EH techniques for UAV-enabled communications with taxonomy, standardization, analytical modeling, and state-of-the-art review
rhetorical_contract.delivery_mechanism: Progressive structure from fundamentals through analytical modeling to categorized literature review with key insights
rhetorical_contract.unique_contribution: First survey combining UAV taxonomy, 3GPP standardization, RF-EH receiver architectures, original analytical modeling, and comprehensive state-of-the-art categorization

Per-subsection literature summaries with problem categories and optimization objectives

Integrated sensing and communication for UAVs

methodology.survey_approach: Comprehensive survey with original analytical modeling and categorized literature review
methodology.source_selection: ~300 references covering UAV communications, EH techniques, and B5G technologies
distinguishing_features: Original analytical modeling with OP/ST/EE derivations
Extensive per-technique literature tables with problem categories

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Use two comparison tables: one for historical surveys (5+ years) and one for recent surveys (1-2 years) to show both evolution and current gap
structure: Table II: Historical surveys (2018-2022) with technology coverage matrix
Table III: Recent surveys (2023-2024) with specific gap identification
Narrative explaining how prior works differ from 'This work'
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Tables II and III comparing 11 prior surveys with checkmark technology coverage
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Demonstrates comprehensive prior art knowledge; clearly positions contribution; shows field maturity

reusable_writing_recipes.description: End each technical subsection with explicit bullet-point 'Key Insights' summarizing actionable takeaways
structure: After Contemporary Research Endeavors narrative
Add explicit heading '2) Key Insights of This Section:'
4-5 bullet points synthesizing lessons learned
Focus on what readers should remember, not just what was discussed
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Every subsection in Sections V-VIII ends with Key Insights
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Enables quick scanning; provides clear takeaways; aids dissertation-style reading
reusable_writing_recipes.complexity: Low - requires synthesis mindset during writing

reusable_writing_recipes.description: For each technique category, create a table classifying works by problem category, solving technique, and optimization objectives
structure: Columns: Works, Model, Problem Category/Technique, Objective columns (trajectory/attributes/throughput/outages), Protocol
One row per cited work with concise descriptors
Checkmarks for optimization objectives covered
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Tables IX-XIV for NOMA, BSC, Multi-User, Multi-UAV, PHY-Security
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Enables quick reference; shows breadth of coverage; facilitates gap identification

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Include a dedicated section with original analytical modeling using representative system model to provide fresh numerical insights
structure: Define system model with figure
State channel model assumptions
Derive key metrics (OP, ST, EE) mathematically
Present numerical results with multiple parameter sweeps
Draw insights about optimal parameter ranges
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section IV with composite channel model and OP/ST/EE derivations
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Demonstrates technical depth; provides actionable numerical insights; distinguishes from pure literature surveys

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Organize state-of-the-art review into four distinct tiers: Physical Layer → Networks → Computing → ML/AI
structure: Section V: Physical layer techniques (MIMO, NOMA, PHY-security)
Section VI: Network types (relaying, CRN, SATN, IoT)
Section VII: Computing technologies (MEC, fog)
Section VIII: ML/AI algorithms (DRL, FL)
Each tier with subsections, tables, and key insights
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Sections V-VIII organized by technology abstraction layer
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Provides clear navigation; separates concerns; enables modular reading

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Frame the survey around two symmetric scenarios: 'Technology-empowered UAV' and 'UAV-enabled Technology'
structure: Scenario 1: RF-EH empowered UAV (UAV harvests energy)
Scenario 2: UAV-enabled RF-EH (UAV transmits energy to devices)
Map each literature work to one of the two scenarios
Use scenario distinction in table classifications
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section IV distinguishes EH-empowered UAV vs UAV-enabled EH
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Provides symmetric framework; enables comprehensive coverage; clarifies paper positioning

key_concepts.rf_eh_uav_integration: Fusion of RF-EH techniques with UAV communications to address onboard power constraints and enable sustainable aerial platforms
key_concepts.swipt: Technique enabling simultaneous wireless information and power transfer through TS, PS, or hybrid receiver architectures
key_concepts.composite_channel: A2G channel model combining Nakagami-m fading with log-normal shadowing and probabilistic LoS/NLoS
